postmortem_report.hospital: Safdarjung Hospital, Department of Forensic Medicine

postmortem_conducted_by.name: Dr. Ashok Kumar Sharma
postmortem_conducted_by.designation: Senior Medical Officer, Department of Forensic Medicine

identification_marks: Old surgical scar on right knee (knee replacement surgery 2019)

postmortem_changes.rigor_mortis: Present in all limbs, jaw - corresponds to 8-10 hours after death
postmortem_changes.livor_mortis: Fixed, on dependent parts (back and legs) - indicates body was in supine position
postmortem_changes.body_temperature: 12°C ambient, body temperature 28°C - confirms death 8-12 hours prior

external_examination.clothing: Bloodstained salwar kameez (maroon and cream), torn at multiple places indicating struggle

injuries.size: 8 cm x 3 cm x 6 cm deep
injuries.description: Clean-cut incised wound extending from right side of neck crossing midline. Carotid artery and jugular vein completely severed. Trachea partially cut.

injuries.location: Left anterior chest, 4th intercostal space, 2 cm from midline
injuries.description: Penetrating wound entering left thoracic cavity, puncturing left lung upper lobe. No cardiac involvement.

injuries.size: 2.5 cm x 1 cm x 4 cm deep
injuries.description: Superficial - did not penetrate thoracic cavity

injuries.size: Three separate cuts: 5 cm, 4 cm, 3 cm
injuries.description: Clean-cut defensive wounds, consistent with victim grabbing blade of knife to defend herself
Simple fracture of distal radius - consistent with severe twisting or fall during struggle
Blunt injury, likely from fall on hard surface after stabbing

internal_examination.neck: Deep incised wound fully cutting through right sternocleidomastoid muscle, common carotid artery, internal jugular vein, and vagus nerve. Blood in surrounding tissues.
internal_examination.chest: Left lung with 2cm puncture wound. Right lung normal. Heart normal. Approximately 500ml blood in left pleural cavity.
internal_examination.abdomen: Normal, no injuries to abdominal organs
internal_examination.head: No skull fracture. Brain normal. Small subarachnoid hemorrhage due to hypotension

cause_of_death.immediate_cause: Hemorrhagic shock due to severance of right common carotid artery and jugular vein (Injury No. 1)
contributing_causes: Left lung laceration with hemothorax (Injury No. 2)

samples_preserved: Nail clippings from both hands (may contain accused's DNA under nails from struggle)

forensic_opinion.weapon_type: Sharp-edged, pointed weapon (kitchen knife as recovered matches wound pattern)
forensic_opinion.manner_of_infliction: All injuries antemortem, inflicted while victim was alive and struggling
forensic_opinion.sequence_of_injuries: Defence wounds on hands first (while defending), then multiple stabs to chest, finally the fatal neck wound
forensic_opinion.number_of_attackers: Single attacker based on wound pattern and trajectory
forensic_opinion.position_of_victim: Victim likely standing/sitting during initial attack, collapsed and died on floor
forensic_opinion.duration_of_survival: Victim survived approximately 5-10 minutes after fatal wound

postmortem_report.opinion_note: The injuries described above are sufficient to cause death in the ordinary course of nature. The nature, number, and location of injuries are consistent with a homicidal attack. The defensive wounds clearly indicate the victim tried to protect herself. Death was caused by the incised wound on the neck which severed major blood vessels, resulting in rapid hemorrhagic shock.
